title: Permutation orbifolds and simple current extensions
summary: In this article, we study permutation orbifolds and simple current extensions in the framework of vertex operator (super)algebras. We extend the construction of permutation-twisted modules for tensor products of vertex operator algebras to vertex operator superalgebras with $\frac12\mathbb Z$-grading, including the effect of the canonical involution.
